brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy: separate compartments for different items
requirements.evidence: 6 compartments across 3 bins: div3 for small notions, div2 for tools, full bin for spools and larger items.
3 joint bolts (lockJoints) tie the cells together; 12 solid end caps close the open faces.

requirements.requirement: Shown in use with sewing supplies
requirements.evidence: No sewing props exist in the catalogue; stand-ins (tape measure, tweezers, marker, brush) show the compartments in use.

finish.summary: Three-cell sewing organiser: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 small slots), bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments), bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full (open bin). Open faces closed with end caps and the cells bolted together; 18 parts, about 1600 g of filament and 2197 minutes of printing. Dressed with stand-in props (tape measure, tweezers, marker, brush) because the catalogue has no sewing props. check_build found no issues and meshClash is clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
